column1: # The servers and vendor specs this engine's committed answers come from.
# default records mongo/driver's tapes and holds the server version every
# driver test reads: MongoDB 8.0, the 8.0 LTS line. Bytebase supports MongoDB
# 4.4 and later, which mongo/driver pins with the wire-version refusal its
# client sends, not with a second server.
# mongosh judges mongo/parser's compat.tsv and is no server: MongoDB's server
# does not parse mongosh syntax. It pins mongodb-js/mongosh (Apache-2.0) at
# the release commit in the source tag; the digest is the SHA-256 of the
# shell-api and shell-bson TypeScript files mongo/parser/cmd/mongoshgrammar
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
